attributes.name: bake_resolution_mode
attributes.comment:
Method to specify grid resolution of baked density grid.  Choices are:
		"default": For shaders that are bound to vdb volumes, use vdb resolution.
						For shaders that are bounds to mesh geometries use 100 divisions
		"divisions": Specify number of divisions.
		"voxel size": Specify voxel size.

attributes.name: bake_divisions
attributes.comment: Divide widest axis by this many divisions

attributes.name: bake_voxel_size
attributes.comment: Size of voxel in world space

attributes.name: surface_opacity_threshold
attributes.comment: Accumulated opacity that's considered the 'surface' for computing surface position and Z

attributes.name: diffuse_color
attributes.comment: Reflectance color of the volume. Technically this is called scattering albedo, which is the scattering coefficient divided by the extinction coefficient.

attributes.name: use_diffuse_ramp
attributes.comment: Use a ramp to define different diffuse colors depending on the depth of the volume.

attributes.name: diffuse_min_depth
attributes.comment: Represents the minimum ray depth, or the shortest visible distance a ray has to travel through the volume. This sets the lower bound for the ramp.

attributes.name: diffuse_max_depth
attributes.comment: Represents the maximum ray depth, or the longest visible distance a ray has to travel through the volume. This sets the upper bound for the ramp.

attributes.name: anisotropy
attributes.comment: Value in the interval [-1,1] that defines how foward (1) or backward (-1) scattering the volume is.  A value of 0.0 indicates an isotropic volume.

attributes.name: attenuation_color
attributes.comment: A color to tint (multiply to) the attenuation. Technically the product of attenuation color and intensity is the attenuation (extinction) coefficient.(Note the inverse behavior of color with this parameter.)

attributes.name: attenuation_intensity
attributes.comment: The rate at which the light traversing a volume is attenuated. The attenuation (extinction) coefficient is the product of attenuation_color, attenuation_intensity, and attenuation_factor

attributes.name: attenuation_factor
attributes.comment: Identical in behavior to attenuation_intensity but provided as a second means  to control attenuation, intended for use during lighting as a per-shot or  per-sequence adjustment.

attributes.name: match_diffuse
attributes.comment: Use the same color(s) for attenuation that is/are being used for diffuse.

attributes.name: invert_attenuation_color
attributes.comment: Invert the input attenuation color(s).

attributes.name: use_attenuation_ramp
attributes.comment: Use a ramp to define different attenuation colors depending on the depth of the volume.

attributes.name: attenuation_min_depth
attributes.comment: Represents the minimum ray depth, or the shortest visible distance a ray has to travel through the volume. This sets the lower bound for the ramp.

attributes.name: attenuation_max_depth
attributes.comment: Represents the maximum ray depth, or the longest visible distance a ray has to travel through the volume. This sets the upper bound for the ramp.

attributes.name: emission_intensity
attributes.comment: The rate at which a volume emits light at a given point.  The product of emission color and intensity is the emission coefficient.

attributes.name: emission_color
attributes.comment: A color multiplier for the emission.  The product of emission color and intensity is the emission coefficient

attributes.name: density_min_depth
attributes.comment: Represents the minimum ray depth, or the shortest visible distance a ray has to travel through the volume. This sets the lower bound for the ramp.

attributes.name: density_max_depth
attributes.comment: Represents the maximum ray depth, or the longest visible distance a ray has to travel through the volume. This sets the upper bound for the ramp.

attributes.comment: bound padding defines how much to extend the bounding box of the object. Keep this value as low as possible unless the geometry skips tessellation because control cage bounding box is out of camera frustum but the displacement stretch out of the original object bounding box (pre-displacement). attributes.name: output_mode

		    RGB - R = deformation along S, G = deformation along T, B = average deformation from ref space 
		    deformation_S - deformation along S 
		    deformation_T - deformation along T 
		    deformation_avg - average deformation from ref space

attributes.name: use_warning_color
attributes.comment: If derivatives are missing or zero output the warning color erroring out

attributes.name: warning_color

attributes.name: prime_direction
attributes.comment: which source is used for the prime direction

attributes.name: polarity
attributes.comment: determines which directions are given color A and which are given color B. Switching this effectively swaps the colors

attributes.name: color_a

attributes.name: color_b
attributes.comment: the color of the effect when the difference angle is smallest

attributes.name: object

attributes.name: object_axis
attributes.comment: which axis to use when 'prime direction' is set to 'axis of object'

attributes.name: custom_direction

attributes.name: use_reference_space

attributes.name: input_normal
attributes.comment: specifies an alternate shading normal when bound. The binding multiplier is ignored

attributes.name: input_normal_dial
attributes.comment: controls the amount of influence of the alternate normal

attributes.name: clamping_behavior
attributes.comment: determines how surfaces facing opposite the prime direction are handled

attributes.name: bias
attributes.comment: controls the rate at which the effect increases as the shading normal approaches the prime direction

attributes.name: use_smoothstep
attributes.comment: apply smoothstep function to result

attributes.name: smoothstep_start
attributes.comment: the value at which the effect is considered 100% off

attributes.name: smoothstep_end

attributes.name: falloff_type
attributes.comment: determines how the effect falls off as the difference angle increases

attributes.name: noise_space

attributes.name: use_input_vectors

attributes.name: input_V

attributes.name: seed

attributes.name: frequency_V

attributes.name: amplitude_U
attributes.comment: controls amplitude of U distortion

attributes.name: amplitude_V

attributes.name: fuzz_albedo

attributes.comment: sets the normal distribution function for clearcoat.  GGX is currently isotropic only

attributes.name: clearcoat_refractive_index
attributes.comment: defines the Fresnel behavior

attributes.name: clearcoat_roughness
attributes.comment: the roughness of the clearcoat lobe

attributes.name: clearcoat_thickness
attributes.comment: the thickness of the virtual clearcoat layer. Values > 0 enable absorption

attributes.name: clearcoat_attenuation_color
attributes.comment: the attenuation color of the clearcoat when 'cleacoat thickness' > 0

attributes.name: clearcoat_bending
attributes.comment: (advanced, recommended ON) bends rays based on the clearcoat-refractive-index before evaluating the lobes under clearcoat

attributes.name: use_independent_clearcoat_normal
attributes.comment: specifies whether the clearcoat lobe should use an independent normal

attributes.name: independent_clearcoat_normal
attributes.comment: specifies an independent shading normal (normal map) for the clearcoat lobe

attributes.name: clearcoat_normal_dial
attributes.comment: controls the amount of infuence of the alternate clearcoat normal

attributes.name: show_glitter
attributes.comment: Enables/disables glitter lobes

attributes.name: glitter
attributes.comment: enables/disables glitter model (binary 0|1 for plausibility)

attributes.name: glitter_seed
attributes.comment: The seed for the glitter random number generator

attributes.name: glitter_space
attributes.comment: The space to calculate the worley noise in, defaults to reference space

attributes.name: glitter_density
attributes.comment: controls the number of flakes per unit length; larger density packs more flakes into same space

attributes.name: glitter_randomness
attributes.comment: randomness of flake orientation

attributes.name: glitter_layering_mode
attributes.comment: layering mode for glitter on top of the under material. physical: conserves energy and glitter attenuates under material, additive: breaks energy conservation but glitter is never darker than the under material (eg. use case: snow)

attributes.comment: 0 implies none of this style, 1 implies all the flakes will get this style

attributes.comment: size of the flakes.  Apparent flake size may vary based on how much the flake spheres intersect the surface

attributes.name: glitter_roughness_A
attributes.comment: specular roughness of individual flakes (0 makes flakes mirror-like)

attributes.name: glitter_color_A
attributes.comment: base flake color (use physical metallic color values)

attributes.comment: filename that points to a texture .exr or .tx file (must be mip-mapped and tiled with maketx).

attributes.comment: 0 implies none of this style, 1 implies all the flakes will get this style

attributes.comment: specular roughness of individual flakes (0 makes flakes mirror-like)

attributes.name: glitter_texture_orientation_randomness
attributes.comment: randomly orient each texture

attributes.name: glitter_color_hue_variation
attributes.comment: introduce hue variation in flake color centered at the base flake color's hue on the hue wheel

attributes.name: glitter_color_saturation_variation
attributes.comment: introduce saturation variation in flake color centered at the base flake color's saturation

attributes.name: glitter_color_value_variation
attributes.comment: introduce value variation in flake color centered at the base flake color's value

attributes.name: glitter_jitter
attributes.comment: Controls how much the flakes are randomly offset from a regular grid

attributes.name: glitter_compensate_reference_space_deformation
attributes.comment: (In ReferenceSpace) Compensates for stretch/compression/shear in glitter shapes resulting from animation etc

attributes.name: glitter_approximate_for_secondary_rays
attributes.comment: use an approximation to shade glitter for non-mirror secondary rays

attributes.name: glitter_LOD_quality
attributes.comment: controls quality of glitter at distances where individual flakes cannot be perceived; at lower values, approximation kicks in earlier

attributes.name: glitter_debug_mode
attributes.comment: developer debug visualization modes

attributes.name: metallic
attributes.comment: enables/disables metallic model (binary 0|1 for plausibility)

attributes.name: specular_lightset

attributes.name: show_specular
attributes.comment: enables/disables specular reflections

attributes.name: metallic_color
attributes.comment: the overall reflection color, defines Fresnel behavior

attributes.name: metallic_edge_color
attributes.comment: the reflection color at grazing angles, defines Fresnel behavior

attributes.name: roughness

attributes.comment: Value in the interval [-1,1] that defines how foward (1) or backward (-1) scattering the volume is.  A value of 0.0 indicates an isotropic volume.

attributes.name: bound_padding
attributes.comment: bound padding defines how much to extend the bounding box of the object. Keep this value as low as possible unless the geometry skips tessellation because control cage bounding box is out of camera frustum but the displacement stretch out of the original object bounding box (pre-displacement). Setting the bound padding too large will consume more memory and tessellation time.

attributes.name: vector
attributes.comment: The direction to apply the displacement.  Bind a map with tangent or object space vector values here.

attributes.name: factor
attributes.comment: A multiplier applied to the input vector

attributes.name: source_space
attributes.comment: The space that the map bound to the vector parameter is in

attributes.name: tangent_space_style
attributes.comment: Controls how RGB maps to Tangent, Normal, and Bi-Normal
